records.name: Regional dispatch routing
records.content:
define DispatchOperators as a device with redwood.department:Dispatch.
define RouteExchange as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:route-exchange.
service RouteExchange as json {"service_class":"RouteExchange","actor_cn":"route-exchange","summary":"Regional route coordination.","endpoint":"zpr://route-exchange","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
allow DispatchOperators to access RouteExchange.
records.summary: Dispatch access to regional route coordination

records.name: Fleet telemetry
records.content:
define FleetManagers as a device with redwood.department:Fleet.
define FleetTelemetry as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:fleet-telemetry.
service FleetTelemetry as json {"service_class":"FleetTelemetry","actor_cn":"fleet-telemetry","summary":"Vehicle telemetry ingestion.","endpoint":"zpr://fleet-telemetry","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
allow FleetManagers to access FleetTelemetry.
records.summary: Fleet operator access to vehicle telemetry

records.name: Partner audit
records.content:
define PartnerAuditors as a device with redwood.role:PartnerAuditor.
define ShipmentLedger as a service with device.zpr.adapter.cn:shipment-ledger.
service ShipmentLedger as json {"service_class":"ShipmentLedger","actor_cn":"shipment-ledger","summary":"Partner shipment records.","endpoint":"zpr://shipment-ledger","status":"example only; not deployed"}.
allow PartnerAuditors to access ShipmentLedger.
records.summary: Partner auditor access to shipment records
